description:
CabalSpy ID profile of a crypto trader: X account (followers, age), Telegram,
    KOL badge, the wallets they verified by an on-chain payment (per chain), and
    7-day trading activity. Use it to check who someone is and whether a trader
    really owns the wallets they claim, e.g. "Is @CabalSpySol verified?",
    "Which wallets does this KOL trade with?".

    Pass exactly one of: username (X handle), csid_id, x_id, or address (looks up
    the owner of a wallet). Works on the keyless demo with sandbox identities only
    (try username 'csid_sandbox_kol').

address.description: A wallet address (Solana base58 or 0x EVM). Returns the person who verified it.
address.title: Address

csid_id.description: CabalSpy ID user id (a UUID, the 'sub' of a Login with CabalSpy ID token), e.g. '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000'.
csid_id.title: Csid Id

username.description: X (Twitter) handle of the person, with or without @, e.g. 'CabalSpySol'. Pass exactly one of username, csid_id, x_id or address.
username.title: Username

x_id.description: Numeric X user id, e.g. '1234567890123456789'. Survives handle changes.
x_id.title: X Id

name: csid_profile
